answer_1.quote: We propose RolePlot, a role‑playing framework specifically designed to evaluate and enhance the plot‑progression capabilities of RPAs... The framework includes Plot‑progression Dialogue Dataset Construction and evaluates RPAs' effectiveness to advance the plot primarily according to ... dialogue turns.
answer_1.outputs: dialogue responses and binary plot‑progression labels (0/1) indicating whether the moment should advance the plot

answer_2.quote: Our method achieves an improvement of 10.8%, 10.5% / 8.5%, 7.2% in accuracy and F1 score ... we also measure conversation longevity in dialogue turns and arousal level using the NRC lexicon.

answer_3.quote: GPT-4o serves as the judgement model using the five criteria outlined in Section 3.3 to determine conversation termination and to judge whether each input is an appropriate moment to advance the plot.
methods: prompt‑based judgment with five predefined criteria
criteria: ignoring user requests to advance the storyline

answer_4.quote: Human verification is conducted, with the judgment model achieving an accuracy rate of 76%.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters compare the model's decisions on conversation termination against their own judgments to verify correctness.
